defect: v1 ordinary_segments uses best cyclic Hamming mapping without reverse-complement orientation, so it is an incomplete competitive baseline on bidirectional reads; retain its scores as historical and do not rank it as the fair baseline
corrected_baseline: Frozen research classify_window, disjoint 80-bp windows, minimum tail 80 bp, both orientations with periodic edit distance, max edit fraction 0.225, unique best with edit margin 1, ambiguous and unknown unassigned
normalization: assigned read bp divided by actual total read bp / original source genome bp; do not use edited assembly size to normalize
input: Regenerate exactly the source/read matrix from protocol.json; every regenerated read SHA-256 must match the v1 archived panel receipt before scoring
scoring: Use unchanged injected deficits, signed prediction, error and gates from protocol.json; no fit or change to any estimator after v1 outcome
